subject.title: fix(plugins): clone registration record metadata for transactional rollback isolation

question: Which proof-positive rollback implementation should be the canonical landing branch for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/106647: this PR, https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/108143, or a consolidated branch?
rationale: Both open branches target the same shared transaction boundary and describe the active-record plus registration-envelope isolation invariant; selecting one requires maintainer judgment on the preferred patch and test shape.

options.title: Select one canonical transaction fix
options.body: Compare the latest merge trees and land the narrower complete implementation, carrying over any unique regression coverage from the other branch.

options.title: Request consolidation
options.body: Ask the contributors to converge on one branch if neither patch cleanly contains the desired runtime and regression coverage.

options.title: Pause both branches
options.body: Defer landing until an owner confirms the intended rollback contract for nested plugin metadata and runtime-object identity.

recommendation.title: Select one canonical transaction fix
recommendation.body: Compare the latest merge trees and land the narrower complete implementation, carrying over any unique regression coverage from the other branch.

likelyOwner.reason: Introduced the shared rollback transaction owner and is best positioned by history to judge the intended boundary.
